item.title: Kalshi and Polymarket place new bans on insider trading as senators move to curb prediction markets
item.description: Kalshi and Polymarket, the two biggest prediction market platforms, rushed to announce new industry guardrails on Monday after two key senators announced legislation that could severely curtail the industry’s prospects.

item.title: Gas prices expected to drop in Ottawa by 12 to 15 cents
item.description: Gas prices are expected to tank by 12 to 15 cents on Wednesday, according to an early outlook from price specialists at En-Pro.

item.title: Canadians remain satisfied with government’s handling of COVID-19
item.description: The majority of Canadians say that they are satisfied with how the federal government handled the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: Fire truck in deadly LaGuardia crash lacked equipment needed to trigger warning system, NTSB says
item.description: Two pilots were killed in the collision involving an Air Canada plane and a firefighting truck on the runway at La Guardia Airport.

item.title: Rogers launches Game Day Owner experience contest for Canadian Blue Jays fans
item.description: Rogers has launched the Game Day Owner experience where fans can submit an application for their chance to win one of six once-in-a-lifetime experiences.
